data.name: Free in Body
data.description: When constrained, the subject can easily slip loose. The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject begins its turn grappled or under an effect that impedes its movement (including paralysis, solid fog, slow, and web). The subject gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 1 minute. (Masterful Trick)
